artworks.title: Eurotas River and Taygetus (landscape)
artworks.description: Landscape painters of Laconia fixed the Eurotas and Taygetus as the visible body of the myth Apollodorus tells in prose: Cleocharia the Naiad bore Eurotas to the earth-born Lelex, and the river that drained the Spartan plain still carries the son's name through the land his daughter Sparta wedded to Lacedaemon.
